name: Your furniture
source: The furniture kit from the renter's earlier layout studios: the Fit check (three plans), Room to live (two plans) and the Apartment layout studio (Emerald Green 1211), plus the queen-bed and 55-inch TV study for Emerald Green 1211. The renter then confirmed the desk (the Bestier rotating desk used straight, dark brown, with a rolling task chair and a 32-inch monitor) and that both TVs are 55-inch. No saved positions survived from the earlier tools (they kept drags in the browser only), so positions are the renter's answers about each room, checked with the studio's fit checks.

pieces.label: Queen bed

look.note: Upholstered grey fabric frame and headboard (the renter's colour), with the renter's black quilted comforter from their room photos.

pieces.note: Mattress 60 x 80 in on a 64 x 84 in frame with a 40 in headboard.
pieces.source: Fit check; Room to live uses a 62 x 84 in frame; the TV study uses a 60 x 80 in mattress.

pieces.label: Latitude Run bed

look.note: Brown Oak: a medium warm brown oak with fine straight grain, matt to satin, darker inside the cubbies, with two warm off-white padded panels and black metal fittings. Colours sampled from the maker's photos (the wood about #937761 in light), not from a swatch.

candidate.name: Modern Storage Platform Bed With Integrated Nightstands, Upholstered Headboard, LED Reading Lights & 4 Drawers
candidate.materials: Solid and manufactured wood (oak), velvet upholstery, plug-in power; two built-in USB-C and USB charging ports and a reading light in each tower.
candidate.note: Read by the renter from the product page's Specifications table, its dimension drawing and its product photos; the page itself was not fetched by the studio. The table and the drawing differ by under 1 in on the frame (61.42 W x 83.46 L x 47.24 H for the frame alone, 60.5 x 83.3 x 47.4 on the drawing); the model uses the drawing's figures. The 13 in is the whole side of the oak box from the floor (its front is two 11.8 in drawer fronts on about 1.2 in black feet); the 4.5 in floor clearance is read as the clearance under the inner black metal frame, not the gap under the oak. The 13.8 in on the drawing is the height of the nightstand's underside above the floor (its top, 22 in, is level with the mattress top). The rail, panel, band and cubby sizes are measured from the front photo against the 94 in width (about 1 in either way); the 12 in mattress is chosen inside the maker's 10 to 15 in. Prices are deliberately not recorded.

pieces.note: A bed you may buy, modelled to the maker's dimensions. It comes with its own nightstands, so the separate ones are hidden while it is shown.

pieces.label: Nightstand
pieces.note: The second nightstand; the Apartment layout studio kept it hidden by default.

pieces.label: IKEA STORKLINTA 6-drawer dresser

look.note: Black, as the renter has it (IKEA sells this STORKLINTA as dark-brown oak effect; in the renter's room it is black).

pieces.note: IKEA STORKLINTA 6-drawer dresser, dark brown oak effect, 70 x 48 x 120 cm: two small drawers side by side on top, then four full-width ones (inside 61 x 40 x 16 cm), slab fronts with no handles, a thin top, a recessed plinth on small feet. Tall and narrow, with a wall anchor.
pieces.source: manufacturer: IKEA US article 705.592.78, https://www.ikea.com/us/en/p/storklinta-6-drawer-dresser-dark-brown-oak-effect-anchor-unlock-function-70559278/ (product page measurements and drawing). Renter, 2026-10-15: this is their dresser, not the MALM.

pieces.label: Bestier rotating desk 51 in and monitor

look.note: Dark brown (espresso) wood-grain boards with silver cylindrical posts, from the renter's photos; it reads nearly black under their lighting. The finish and the monitor's casing are stand-ins.

pieces.note: Bestier Rotating L-Shaped Computer Desk 51 in with an open 2-tier shelf (Amazon ASIN B07V9QXDSN, bought 2021): a 51.8 x 21.6 in desk on one panel leg and a 46.9 x 13.4 x 27.6 in S shelf that pivots under its inner end. Used straight: about 89.2 in end to end, derived, not published (measure it; spec.straight.total). L option: set.config l_shape, 51.8 x 46.9 in.
pieces.source: Maker's dimension drawing on the Amazon listing: desk 51.8 x 21.6, height 29.1, shelf 46.9 x 13.4 x 27.6, tiers 11.3, panels 1.65 in. Derived: straight length and pivot, from the maker's L box size (51.18 x 46.85) and straight photo. Finish, posts and straight use: renter's photos.

pieces.label: Office chair (rolling task chair)

look.note: The renter has a rolling office chair with wheels, the one that goes with the desk; the model is a generic task chair with a mesh back and two armrests, black as a stand-in until the renter says what it is.

pieces.note: A rolling task chair, about 27 in across at the casters and 42 in tall; its seat and arms (under 25 in) may tuck under the desktop (27.5 in), its back may not. It is its own piece: shown or hidden with the Office chair switch, and either attached to the desk (it moves and turns with it) or free to drag anywhere and to duplicate.
pieces.source: Renter: they have a rolling office chair with wheels. Size: a typical task chair, an assumption; measure it.

pieces.label: Futon, Serta Billie-Loren

look.note: Black faux leather (the renter's purchase emails: Serta Billie-Loren, WADL9387, variant 19198029) with four splayed brushed-chrome legs as in Wayfair's product photo; the sheen is read from that photo.

pieces.note: Click-clack sofa bed: 73.2 x 33.5 x 35.4 in upright (Wayfair also lists the sofa as 74 in wide), about 73.2 x 39.9 x 30 in as a lounger (worked out from the back length, not listed), 73.2 x 41.7 in as a flat bed. Seat 22.0 in deep, 18.5 in high. No size is verified for this variant.
pieces.source: Renter's purchase emails, Aug 2023 (Wayfair, WADL9387, variant 19198029); sizes: Wayfair listing result, basis: listing (unverified for this variant).

pieces.label: Coffee table
pieces.note: Standard coffee table, 44 x 24 x 17 in.

pieces.label: 55-inch TV, bedroom

look.note: A 55-inch TV is a black panel; the exact casing is assumed.

pieces.note: Wall-mounted, 48.4 x 27.8 in, centre about 46 in off the floor. The Emerald Green study weighs an LG 55 in (48.1 in wide) against a 48 in (42.2 in wide).
pieces.source: Fit check; Room to live (Samsung 55 in spec); Emerald Green 1211 bedroom TV study.

pieces.label: 55-inch TV, living room

look.note: A 55-inch TV is a black panel; the exact casing is assumed.

pieces.note: Wall-mounted, 48.4 x 27.8 in, centre about 46 in off the floor.

pieces.label: Dining table, 4 seats

look.note: Brown wood table for four. The chairs' look is a stand-in.

pieces.note: 48 x 30 in rectangle with four chairs.

pieces.label: Sim rig, Next Level Racing F-GT Lite (GT) with Fanatec wheel

look.note: A folding tubular cockpit: black steel tubes with black-and-red pivot caps, a black fabric sling seat, a central tube to a small flat wheel deck, a black finned Fanatec base and a flat Formula wheel. From the renter's photo and the maker's drawings; finishes are stand-ins.

pieces.note: GT mode by default (the back more upright); the Formula variant reclines the whole seat and lowers the wheel deck. Footprint = the conservative planning envelope 195 x 85 x 130 cm, above every published figure. The side view follows the maker's GT and Formula drawings; seat, wheel-deck and pedal-plate sizes are not published and are drawn by eye. The pedal end slides under the desk.
pieces.source: Renter: product choice, photo, under-desk use. Maker support: GT 175x75x127 cm, Formula 164x75x94 cm; product-space graphic 185x85x125 cm; reseller drawings GT 185.3 cm and Formula 192.4 cm long; folded frame 75x40x87 cm. Envelope: planning value. Fanatec base and wheel sizes: approximate.

confirmed.note: The renter confirmed these are their own pieces, and on 2026-10-15 their colours and materials (each piece's `look`, where its basis is renter). A field listed in `assumed`, the TVs' casing and the chairs are stand-ins. The Latitude Run storage bed is not one of the renter's pieces: it is a candidate purchase, modelled from the maker's dimensions.
